scope: Exact arithmetic skipping in the always-clocked BBD and PRA circuits; no change to physical model, integration rate, clocks, noise, or nonzero tails
evidence_kind: software continuation equivalence, not hardware measurement
oracle: Independent frozen BbdChorus and PraWahCircuit implementations from the baseline commit; only class/include names may change. Existing physical, spectral, source, legacy and V1 gates remain unchanged.

bbd.clock_contract: The DO1/DO2 floating-point phase recurrences and integrated BBD clock still advance at every original sample while all tab combinations are exercised, including off-to-on after long silence.
bbd.noise_contract: Both independent packet-noise streams and all reconstruction/coupling states continue on every original sample, including when both tabs are off.
fixtures: cold zero input with both tabs off
nonzero tails after input becomes zero
zero-history packet shortcut entry and exit
reset and prepare at each rate
bbd.zero_history_representation: The zero-history cache classifies stored magnitude bits, including subnormals independently of the current denormal mode. On SSE/x64, train subnormal history with DAZ enabled and FTZ disabled, then disable DAZ before normal-signal wake; exact output equality still applies.

pra.zero_guard: Only a provably exact zero capacitor graph with zero bounded input may bypass its zero nodal algebra. No epsilon or amplitude threshold is permitted. Signed zero output/state bits remain part of equality.
pra.optical_contract: Every original opticalLog recurrence remains clocked, including pedal/resistance movement during silence before a nonzero input wakes the graph.
fixtures: nonfinite input through the existing numerical guard
moving pedal and resistance in silence
first nonzero sample after long silence
nonzero capacitor tail with zero input
reset and prepare at each rate

mutations_required: force zero-packet bypass with nonzero history
bypass PRA for zero input despite charged capacitors
freeze PRA optical movement in the zero-state path
classify stored BBD history through the current DAZ floating comparison
performance: Root compares the unchanged source_factory_benchmark baseline and candidate with at least three rounds per snapshot. Timing is diagnostic and cannot substitute for the exact continuation gates.
